treatments.icsi.recovery: Kamar na IVF: kusan makonni 3 zuwa 4 a Indiya don zagaye ɗaya.
treatments.icsi.faq.0.question: Idan babu maniyyi a cikin abin da aka fitar fa?
treatments.icsi.faq.0.answer: Sau da yawa ana iya ɗaukar maniyyi daga ƙwalatai a cikin ƙaramin aiki a yi amfani da shi don ICSI.
treatments.icsi.faq.1.question: Shin ICSI ya fi IVF nasara?
treatments.icsi.faq.1.answer: Ba gaba ɗaya ba. Yana taimakawa musamman idan matsalar tana tare da maniyyi.
treatments.knee-replacement.name: Cikakken maye gurbin gwiwa
treatments.knee-replacement.summary: Tiyata da ke maye gurbin saman gaɓar gwiwa da suka lalace da sassan ƙarfe da roba.
treatments.knee-replacement.what: Ana cire saman ƙashin cinya da na ƙauri da suka lalace a rufe su da sassan ƙarfe, tare da roba a tsakaninsu domin gaɓar ta yi motsi cikin sauƙi. Ana iya amfani da na'urar kwamfuta ko mutum-mutumi (robot) don sanya sassan daidai.
treatments.knee-replacement.who: Mutanen da ke da tsananin ciwon gwiwa da taurinta sakamakon amosanin gaɓoɓi wanda ke hana tafiya da barci, idan magunguna, allurai da physiotherapy ba su taimakawa kuma.
treatments.knee-replacement.stay: Kusan kwanaki 6 don gwiwa ɗaya (1 a ICU, 5 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya), ko kwanaki 8 don duka biyu (2 da 6) a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.knee-replacement.recovery: Ana fara tafiya da taimako washegarin tiyata. Yawancin mutane suna tafiya da kansu cikin makonni 4 zuwa 6 kuma suna tashi zuwa gida bayan kusan makonni 2 zuwa 3.
treatments.knee-replacement.faq.0.questi: Ana iya yin gwiwoyi biyu tare?
treatments.knee-replacement.faq.0.answer: Sau da yawa, eh, idan lafiyarku ta yarda. Hakan yana nufin zama ɗaya a asibiti da murmurewa ɗaya.
treatments.knee-replacement.faq.1.questi: Har yaushe maye gurbin gwiwa yake ɗorewa?
treatments.knee-replacement.faq.1.answer: Yawancinsu suna ɗorewa shekaru 15 zuwa 20 ko fiye.
treatments.hip-replacement.name: Cikakken maye gurbin kwatangwalo
treatments.hip-replacement.summary: Tiyata da ke maye gurbin gaɓar kwatangwalo da ta lalace da ƙwallo da kwano na roba (na wucin gadi).
treatments.hip-replacement.what: Ana maye gurbin ƙwallon da ya lalace a saman ƙashin cinya da kwanon da ke ƙashin ƙugu da sassan wucin gadi da aka yi da ƙarfe, yumɓu (ceramic) ko roba.
treatments.hip-replacement.who: Mutanen da ke da tsananin ciwon kwatangwalo da taurinsa sakamakon amosanin gaɓoɓi, karayar kwatangwalo, ko rashin isar jini zuwa ƙashin kwatangwalo (avascular necrosis).
treatments.hip-replacement.stay: Kusan kwanaki 6 don kwatangwalo ɗaya (1 a ICU, 5 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya), ko kwanaki 8 don duka biyu (2 da 6) a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.hip-replacement.recovery: Ana fara tafiya da taimako washegarin tiyata. Yawancin mutane suna tafiya da kansu cikin makonni 4 zuwa 6 kuma suna tashi zuwa gida bayan kusan makonni 2.
treatments.hip-replacement.faq.0.questio: Har yaushe maye gurbin kwatangwalo yake ɗorewa?
treatments.hip-replacement.faq.0.answer: Yawancinsu suna ɗorewa shekaru 15 zuwa 20 ko fiye.
treatments.hip-replacement.faq.1.questio: Akwai motsin da dole ne in guje wa?
treatments.hip-replacement.faq.1.answer: A makonnin farko, eh. Ma'aikacin physiotherapy zai nuna muku yadda za ku zauna, ku sunkuya kuma ku hau matakala lafiya.
treatments.acl-reconstruction.name: Sake gina jijiyar gwiwa (ACL)
treatments.acl-reconstruction.summary: Tiyata ta ƙananan ramuka da ke sake gina jijiyar anterior cruciate ligament da ta tsage, ɗaya daga cikin manyan jijiyoyin da ke cikin gwiwa.
treatments.acl-reconstruction.what: Ta ƙananan yanka, likitan fiɗa yana maye gurbin jijiyar da ta tsage da wani yanki na jijiya (tendon), yawanci daga ƙafar majiyyacin kansa, a ɗaure shi cikin ƙasusuwan sama da ƙasan gwiwa.
treatments.acl-reconstruction.who: Mutane masu ƙwazo da ACL ɗinsu ya tsage kuma gwiwarsu tana kasawa, musamman masu wasanni ko aikin ƙarfi.
treatments.acl-reconstruction.stay: Yawanci kwanaki 1 zuwa 2 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.acl-reconstruction.recovery: Ana fara tafiya da taimako cikin ʼyan kwanaki. Komawa wasanni yawanci yana ɗaukar watanni 6 zuwa 9 na physiotherapy.
treatments.acl-reconstruction.faq.0.ques: Zan iya tashi zuwa gida jim kaɗan bayan haka?
treatments.acl-reconstruction.faq.0.answ: Yawanci bayan kusan makonni 1 zuwa 2, bayan an duba raunin kuma an fara physiotherapy.
treatments.acl-reconstruction.faq.1.ques: Ana iya gyara wani lahani na gwiwa a lokaci ɗaya?
treatments.acl-reconstruction.faq.1.answ: Eh. Guringuntsin da ya tsage (meniscus) sau da yawa ana gyara shi a cikin tiyata ɗaya.
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.name: Tiyatar ketare jijiyar zuciya (CABG)
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.summary: Tiyatar ketare jijiyar zuciya: ana amfani da jijiyar jini daga wani wuri a jiki domin karkatar da jini ya kewaye jijiyar zuciya da ta takura ko ta toshe.
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.what: Ana ɗaukar lafiyayyar jijiyar jini daga ƙirji, hannu ko ƙafa a haɗa ta da jijiyar zuciya bayan toshewar, domin jini ya kewaye ta. Ana iya yin ta yayin da zuciya take bugawa (off-pump) ko da na'urar zuciya da huhu, kuma ga wasu majiyyata ta ƙananan yanka.
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.who: Mutanen da ke da jijiyoyin zuciya da dama da suka toshe, babbar jijiya da ta toshe, ko ciwon suga tare da cutar jijiyoyin zuciya, da waɗanda sanya stent bai dace da su ba.
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.stay: Kusan kwanaki 7 zuwa 9: 3 zuwa 5 a sashen kulawa ta musamman (ICU), gwargwadon haɗari, da 4 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa ayyuka masu sauƙi cikin makonni 4 zuwa 6, kuma cikakkun ayyuka cikin kusan watanni 3. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan makonni 2 zuwa 3 bayan tiyata.
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.faq.0.qu: Bypass ko stent: wanne ya fi dacewa da ni?
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.faq.0.an: Ya danganta da yawan jijiyoyin da suka toshe da kuma inda suke. Ƙungiyar likitocin zuciya za ta duba hoton jijiyoyinku (angiogram) ta ba ku shawara.
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.faq.1.qu: Yaushe zan iya tashi zuwa gida?
treatments.heart-bypass-surgery.faq.1.an: Yawanci kusan makonni 2 zuwa 3 bayan tiyata, bayan an duba ku.
treatments.minimally-invasive-heart-surg: Tiyatar zuciya ta ƙananan yanka tsakanin haƙarƙari maimakon buɗe ƙashin ƙirji.

Likitan fiɗa yana kaiwa ga zuciya ta ƙaramin yanka a gefen ƙirji, yana amfani da kayan aiki na musamman da kuma kyamara wani lokaci. Ana iya amfani da ita don gyara ko maye gurbin ƙofar zuciya (valve), wasu tiyatocin ketare jijiya da rufe ramuka a zuciya.
Zaɓaɓɓun mutanen da ke buƙatar tiyatar ƙofar zuciya, ketare jijiya ko wata tiyatar zuciya, gwargwadon yanayin zuciyarsu da lafiyarsu gaba ɗaya.
Yawanci kwanaki 4 zuwa 6 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
Sau da yawa ya fi tiyatar zuciya ta yau da kullum sauri: mutane da yawa suna komawa ayyuka masu sauƙi cikin makonni 2 zuwa 4.
A'a. Ya danganta da irin tiyatar da yanayin zuciyarku. Likitan fiɗa zai ba ku shawara bayan ya duba gwaje-gwajenku.
Shin sakamakon ɗaya ne da na tiyatar yau da kullum?
Ga majiyyatan da suka dace, eh, tare da ƙaramin tabo da yawanci murmurewa cikin sauri.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.name: Maye gurbin ƙofar zuciya (valve)
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.summa: Tiyata ko aiki ta bututu (catheter) da ke maye gurbin ƙofar zuciya da ta takura sosai ko take zubewa, da ƙofar ƙarfe ko ta nama.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.what: Ana gyara ƙofar da ta lalace idan zai yiwu, ko a maye gurbinta da ƙofar ƙarfe (wadda take ɗorewa sosai amma tana buƙatar maganin tsinke jini har abada) ko ƙofar nama. Wasu majiyyata za a iya sanya musu sabuwar ƙofa ta bututu daga ƙafa (TAVI) maimakon tiyatar buɗe ƙirji.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.who: Mutanen da ke da ƙofar zuciya da ta takura ko take zubewa wadda ke haddasa ƙarancin numfashi, ciwon ƙirji, gajiya ko suma, sau da yawa bayan zazzaɓin rheumatic ko saboda tsufa.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.stay: Kusan kwanaki 7 don ƙofa ɗaya: 3 a sashen kulawa ta musamman (ICU) da 4 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.recov: Yawanci makonni 6 zuwa 8 don tiyatar buɗe ƙirji, ƙasa da haka don hanyoyin ƙananan yanka ko na bututu. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan makonni 2 zuwa 3.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.faq.0: Ƙofofin ƙarfe sun fi ɗorewa amma suna buƙatar maganin tsinke jini kowace rana. Ƙofofin nama ba sa buƙatar wannan amma suna iya lalacewa bayan shekaru 10 zuwa 20. Likitan fiɗa zai taimaka muku zaɓa.
treatments.heart-valve-replacement.faq.1: Ana iya gyara ƙofata maimakon haka?
Sau da yawa, musamman ƙofofin mitral da ke zubewa. An fi son gyara idan zai yiwu.
treatments.angioplasty.name: Buɗe jijiyar zuciya da sanya stent (angioplasty)
treatments.angioplasty.summary: Ana shigar da siririn bututu zuwa jijiyar zuciya da ta takura, ƙaramin balan-balan yana faɗaɗa ta, kuma yawanci ana barin bututun raga da ake kira stent don ya riƙe ta a buɗe.
treatments.angioplasty.what: Ta ɗan ƙaramin rami a wuyan hannu ko maɗaurin cinya, ana jagorantar siririn bututu zuwa zuciya. Hoton jijiya (angiogram) yana nuna toshewar, balan-balan yana buɗe ta, kuma ana barin stent mai shafe da magani a wurin domin ya riƙe ta a buɗe.
treatments.angioplasty.who: Mutanen da ke da ciwon ƙirji ko bugun zuciya (heart attack) sakamakon jijiyar zuciya ɗaya ko ʼyan kaɗan da suka takura.
treatments.angioplasty.stay: Kusan kwanaki 2: 1 a sashen kulawa ta musamman (ICU) da 1 a cikin ɗakin marasa lafiya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.angioplasty.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin kusan mako ɗaya, kuma yawanci suna iya tashi zuwa gida bayan ʼyan kwanaki.
treatments.angioplasty.faq.0.question: Ana yin ta ne da maganin sa barci gaba ɗaya?
treatments.angioplasty.faq.0.answer: A'a. Ana yin ta ne da maganin kashe jin wuri ɗaya, kuma kuna a farke amma cikin jin daɗi.
treatments.angioplasty.faq.1.question: Zan buƙaci magunguna daga baya?
treatments.angioplasty.faq.1.answer: Eh, maganin tsinke jini na wasu watanni don kare stent ɗin, da magunguna don kare zuciya.
treatments.ecmo.name: ECMO (tallafin zuciya da huhu)
treatments.ecmo.summary: Na'ura tana ɗaukar aikin zuciya da huhu na kwanaki ko makonni, don ba su lokaci su murmure.
treatments.ecmo.what: Ana jan jini ta bututu, a wuce da shi ta huhun wucin gadi wanda ke ƙara iskar oxygen ya kuma cire carbon dioxide, sannan a mayar da shi. Ana amfani da shi a sashen kulawa ta musamman don mafi tsananin gazawar zuciya ko huhu, ko don tallafa wa tiyatar zuciya mai sarƙaƙiya.
treatments.ecmo.who: Mutanen da ke cikin matuƙar rashin lafiya da tsananin gazawar zuciya ko huhu wadda ba ta amsa wani magani ba, misali bayan bugun zuciya, tsananin ciwon huhu (pneumonia) ko tiyatar zuciya.
treatments.ecmo.stay: A sashen kulawa ta musamman, muddin ana buƙatar tallafi, yawanci kwanaki zuwa makonni.
treatments.ecmo.recovery: Ya danganta da rashin lafiyar da ta sa aka buƙaci ECMO. Ƙungiyar likitoci za ta bayyana kowane mataki ga iyali.
treatments.ecmo.faq.0.question: Ana iya kawo majiyyaci Indiya yana kan ECMO?
treatments.ecmo.faq.0.answer: A wasu lokuta, tare da ƙungiyar jirgin sama na asibiti (air ambulance). Ku tuntuɓe mu cikin gaggawa za mu tambayi asibitin.
treatments.ecmo.faq.1.question: Shin ECMO magani ne shi kansa?
treatments.ecmo.faq.1.answer: Yana tallafa wa jiki yayin da zuciya ko huhu suke murmurewa, ko har sai wani magani, kamar tiyata, ya yiwu.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.name: Kulawar zuciya da ciwon suga
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.summary: Duba lafiya da tsarin magani na ƙwararru don cutar zuciya da ciwon suga tare, da nufin hana bugun zuciya da shanyewar ɓarin jiki (stroke).
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.what: Likita da ke kula da duka cututtukan biyu yana duba tarihin lafiyarku, gwaje-gwajenku da magungunanku, ya tsara maganin sukarin jini, hawan jini da cholesterol tare. Gwaje-gwaje na iya haɗawa da ECG, echo, gwajin zuciya yayin motsa jiki (stress test) da gwajin jini.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.who: Mutanen da ke da ciwon suga, hawan jini, yawan cholesterol ko tarihin cutar zuciya a iyali, da waɗanda suke son cikakken duban zuciya yayin ziyararsu.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: ana yin gwaje-gwaje da ganawa da likita ba tare da kwanciya ba, yawanci cikin kwanaki 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.recovery: Babu lokacin murmurewa. Tsarin zai iya ci gaba tare da likitanku a gida.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.faq.0.que: Zan iya yin duban zuciya yayin da nake Indiya saboda wani abu daban?
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.faq.0.ans: Eh. Za mu iya tsara shi tare da sauran ganawarku.
treatments.heart-diabetes-care.faq.1.ans: Mai yiwuwa. Likita zai bayyana duk wani canji kuma ya raba tsarin da likitanku na gida.
treatments.varicose-veins.name: Maganin kumburarrun jijiyoyin ƙafa (varicose veins)
treatments.varicose-veins.summary: Ana rufe kumburarrun jijiyoyin ƙafa masu ciwo daga ciki da zafi ko magani, ta ɗan ƙaramin rami, ba tare da tiyatar buɗewa ba.
treatments.varicose-veins.what: Da jagorancin ultrasound, ana shigar da siririn bututu cikin jijiyar da ta lalace, kuma zafi (laser ko radiofrequency) ko manne na likita yana rufe ta. Sannan jini yana gudana ta lafiyayyun jijiyoyi. Ana iya magance ƙananan jijiyoyi da allura. Ana kuma iya magance daskarewar jini a zurfin jijiya (DVT) ta bututu (catheter).
treatments.varicose-veins.who: Mutanen da ke da varicose veins da ke haddasa ciwo, kumburi, canjin fata ko gyambo, da wasu masu daskarewar jini a zurfin jijiya (DVT).
treatments.varicose-veins.stay: Yawanci aiki ne na rana ɗaya, ko dare 1 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.varicose-veins.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna tafiya nan take kuma suna komawa harkokinsu cikin ʼyan kwanaki, suna sanya safa mai matsewa na mako ɗaya ko biyu.
treatments.varicose-veins.faq.0.question: Shin yana da zafi?
treatments.varicose-veins.faq.0.answer: Ana yin sa ne da maganin kashe jin wuri ɗaya. Ɗan ciwo na ʼyan kwanaki abu ne da aka saba.
treatments.varicose-veins.faq.1.question: Jijiyoyin za su iya dawowa?
treatments.varicose-veins.faq.1.answer: Sababbin varicose veins na iya fitowa cikin shekaru, kuma ana iya sake magance su.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.sum: Ana buɗe jijiyoyin ƙafa da suka takura ko suka toshe da balan-balan ko stent ta ɗan ƙaramin rami, don rage ciwo yayin tafiya da kuma ceton ƙafa.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.wha: Ta ɗan ƙaramin rami, ƙwararren likitan hoto (interventional radiologist) yana jagorantar siririn bututu zuwa jijiyar da ta toshe, ya buɗe ta da balan-balan, kuma yana iya sanya stent. Idan hakan ba zai yiwu ba, ana iya ba da shawarar tiyatar ketare jijiya.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.who: Mutanen da ke da ciwon ƙafa yayin tafiya, ciwo a lokacin hutu, ko raunukan da ba sa warkewa saboda ƙarancin gudanar jini, sau da yawa tare da ciwon suga ko tarihin shan taba.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.sta: Yawanci kwanaki 1 zuwa 2 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.rec: Yawancin mutane suna tafiya a ranar ko washegari kuma suna komawa harkokinsu cikin mako ɗaya.
treatments.peripheral-artery-disease.faq: Dawo da gudanar jini na iya taimaka wa raunuka su warke kuma sau da yawa yana ceton ƙafa. Da wuri aka yi magani, da kyau.
Eh, yawanci maganin tsinke jini da magungunan cholesterol, da taimako don daina shan taba.
treatments.hand-surgery.name: Tiyatar hannu da sake gina shi
treatments.hand-surgery.summary: Tiyata don gyara hannayen da suka ji rauni ko suka lalace da dawo da amfaninsu, daga yankakkun jijiyoyi (tendon) da jijiyoyin ji zuwa mayar da yatsu.
treatments.hand-surgery.what: Likitan fiɗar hannu yana gyara tendon, jijiyoyin ji, jijiyoyin jini da ƙasusuwa ƙarƙashin madubin hangen nesa, yana mayar da yatsun da aka yanke, yana sakin yatsun da suka yi tauri ko suka naɗe, kuma yana sake gina sassan da suka ɓace da naman da aka ɗauko daga wani wuri. Maganin motsa hannu (hand therapy) bayan haka muhimmin ɓangare ne na murmurewa.
treatments.hand-surgery.who: Mutanen da ke da raunin hannu, matsewar jijiyar ji kamar carpal tunnel syndrome, yatsu masu tauri ko lanƙwasa, bambance-bambancen hannu tun haihuwa, ko raunin aikin hannu bayan tsohon rauni.
treatments.hand-surgery.stay: Yawanci daga aikin rana ɗaya zuwa kwanaki 3 a asibiti, gwargwadon irin tiyatar. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.hand-surgery.recovery: Daga makonni 2 don ƙaramar tiyata zuwa watanni da dama tare da hand therapy don gyare-gyare masu sarƙaƙiya.
treatments.hand-surgery.faq.0.question: Ana iya inganta tsohon rauni har yanzu?
treatments.hand-surgery.faq.0.answer: Sau da yawa, eh. Sauya wurin tendon da jijiyoyin ji na iya dawo da motsi shekaru bayan rauni.
treatments.hand-surgery.faq.1.question: Ina buƙatar hand therapy?
treatments.hand-surgery.faq.1.answer: Eh. Maganin motsa hannu yana da muhimmanci kamar tiyatar kanta wajen dawo da motsi.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.name: Tiyatar brachial plexus da jijiyoyin ji
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.summa: Tiyata don gyara jijiyoyin ji daga wuya zuwa hannu, bayan rauni ko tun haihuwa, don dawo da motsi a kafaɗa, hannu da tafin hannu.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.what: Brachial plexus dami ne na jijiyoyin ji da ke sarrafa hannu. Ƙarƙashin madubin hangen nesa, likitan fiɗa yana gyara jijiyoyin da suka lalace, yana amfani da dashen jijiya, ko yana sauya wurin jijiyoyi ko tsokoki masu aiki domin dawo da motsi. Lokaci yana da muhimmanci: jijiyoyi sun fi murmurewa idan aka gyara su cikin ʼyan watanni da rauni.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.who: Manya masu raunin hannu ko shanyewar hannu bayan hatsarin mota ko faɗuwa, da jarirai masu raunin hannu sakamakon haihuwa mai wahala (birth brachial plexus palsy).
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwanaki 3 zuwa 5 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.recov: Jijiyoyi suna girma a hankali, don haka motsi yana dawowa cikin watanni 6 zuwa shekaru 2, tare da physiotherapy na dogon lokaci.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.faq.0: Shin lokaci ya wuce idan raunin ya kai shekara ɗaya?
Ba koyaushe ba. Ko da gyaran jijiya bai yiwuwa kuma, sauya wurin jijiya ko tsoka na iya taimakawa har yanzu.
treatments.brachial-plexus-surgery.faq.1: Yaushe ya kamata a kai jariri a duba shi?
Da wuri gwargwadon iko, mafi kyau cikin ʼyan watannin farko, domin likitan fiɗa ya bi murmurewar ya kuma yi tiyata a lokacin da ya dace.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.n: Tiyatar sake gina jiki ta ƙananan jijiyoyi (microsurgery)
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.s: Sake gina sassan jiki bayan rauni ko tiyatar daji ta hanyar ɗauko nama, tare da jijiyoyin jininsa, daga wani wuri a jiki.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.w: Ana ɗauko fata, tsoka ko ƙashi daga wani sashe na jiki zuwa wani, kuma ana haɗa ƙananan jijiyoyin jininsa ƙarƙashin madubin hangen nesa domin ya rayu. Ana amfani da ita don rufe raunuka, sake gina fuska, nono ko muƙamuƙi bayan tiyatar daji, da ceton ƙafafun da suka ji mummunan rauni waɗanda in ba haka ba za a iya yanke su.
Mutanen da ke da manyan raunuka ko naman da ya ɓace bayan hatsari, ƙonewa, kamuwa da cuta ko tiyatar daji, ciki har da mummunan raunin ƙafa.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.s: Yawanci kwanaki 5 zuwa 10 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.r: Yawanci makonni 4 zuwa 8, fiye da haka don sake gina ƙafa, tare da physiotherapy.
treatments.reconstructive-microsurgery.f: Ana iya ceton ƙafata bayan mummunan rauni?
Sau da yawa, ko da bayan munanan raunuka. Ƙungiyar likitoci za ta duba ƙashi, fata da gudanar jini kafin ta yanke shawara.
Za a sami tabo a inda aka ɗauko naman?
Eh, amma likitan fiɗa yana zaɓar wurin da ba a fi gani ba kuma ba ya shafar aiki sosai.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.name: Tiyatar lymphoedema (microsurgery na jijiyoyin lymph)
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.summary: Microsurgery da ke taimaka wa ruwa ya fita daga hannu ko ƙafa da ta kumbura, sau da yawa bayan maganin daji.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.what: Lymphoedema kumburi ne da ke faruwa idan ruwan lymph bai iya fita ba. Ƙarƙashin madubin hangen nesa, likitan fiɗa yana haɗa ƙananan jijiyoyin lymph da ƙananan jijiyoyin jini domin ruwan ya fita (lymphovenous bypass), ko yana ɗauko lafiyayyun ƙwayoyin lymph (lymph nodes) zuwa gaɓar da ta kumbura.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.who: Mutanen da ke da kumburin hannu ko ƙafa saboda lymphoedema, sau da yawa bayan tiyatar daji na nono ko na mahaifa ko maganin hasken rediyo, idan matsewa da magani ba su isa ba.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwanaki 1 zuwa 3 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu cikin makonni 2 zuwa 3. Kumburi yana raguwa a hankali cikin watanni, tare da ci gaba da matsewa.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.faq.0.ans: Yawanci yana raguwa, sau da yawa sosai, amma ƙila ba zai ɓace gaba ɗaya ba. Maganin da wuri yana ba da sakamako mafi kyau.
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.faq.1.que: Har yanzu ina buƙatar tufafi masu matsewa?
treatments.lymphoedema-surgery.faq.1.ans: Yawanci eh, na ɗan lokaci bayan tiyata. Mutane da yawa suna iya rage sanya su da lokaci.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.nam: Tiyatar gyaran jiki ga yara da bambance-bambancen haihuwa
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.sum: Tiyata ga yaran da aka haifa da bambance-bambance kamar tsagewar leɓe da ɗanɗano (cleft lip and palate), bambance-bambancen hannu da alamomin haihuwa, ko da tabo daga raunuka da ƙonewa.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.wha: Likitan tiyatar gyaran jiki da ke yi wa yara tiyata yana gyara tsagewar leɓe da ɗanɗano, yana raba yatsun da suka haɗe, yana gyara sauran bambance-bambancen hannu da fuska, kuma yana sakin tabon ƙuna mai matsewa, a lokacin da ya dace da girman yaron.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.who: Jarirai da yara masu tsagewar leɓe ko ɗanɗano, bambance-bambancen hannu ko fuska tun haihuwa, alamomin haihuwa, ko tabo bayan raunuka da ƙonewa.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.sta: Yawanci kwanaki 1 zuwa 3 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.rec: Yawanci makonni 1 zuwa 3. Wasu yanayi suna buƙatar tiyata fiye da ɗaya yayin da yaron yake girma.
treatments.childrens-plastic-surgery.faq: Wane shekaru ne mafi dacewa don tiyata?
Ya danganta da yanayin. Ana yawan gyara tsagewar leɓe a kusan watanni 3 zuwa 6, tsagewar ɗanɗano kuma kafin kusan watanni 18.
Mahaifi ko mahaifiya za su iya zama tare da yaron?
Eh. Ɗaya daga cikin iyaye yana zama tare da yaron a asibiti a duk tsawon lokacin.
treatments.rhinoplasty.name: Rhinoplasty (gyaran siffar hanci)
treatments.rhinoplasty.summary: Tiyata don canza siffa ko girman hanci, don kyan gani, don numfashi, ko duka biyu.
treatments.rhinoplasty.what: Likitan fiɗa yana gyara siffar ƙashi da guringuntsin hanci, yawanci ta yanka a cikin hanci ko ƙaramin yanka tsakanin kofofin hanci. Ana iya miƙe katangar hanci (septum) da ta karkace a cikin tiyata ɗaya don taimakawa numfashi.
treatments.rhinoplasty.who: Manya da suke son canza siffar hancinsu, ko waɗanda ke da matsalar numfashi saboda karkataccen septum ko tsohon rauni.
treatments.rhinoplasty.stay: Yawanci aiki ne na rana ɗaya ko dare 1 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.rhinoplasty.recovery: Ana barin abin tallafi (splint) na kusan mako ɗaya. Yawancin kumburi da ɓarɓashin jini suna wucewa cikin makonni 2, kuma siffar ƙarshe tana bayyana cikin watanni.
treatments.rhinoplasty.faq.0.question: Yaushe zan iya tashi zuwa gida?
treatments.rhinoplasty.faq.0.answer: Yawanci bayan kusan kwanaki 7 zuwa 10, bayan an cire splint ɗin.
treatments.rhinoplasty.faq.1.question: Zai gyara numfashina kuma?
treatments.rhinoplasty.faq.1.answer: Idan matsalar karkataccen septum ce, ana iya gyara ta a cikin tiyata ɗaya.
treatments.liposuction.name: Liposuction (zuƙe kitse)
treatments.liposuction.summary: Tiyata da ke cire kitse daga zaɓaɓɓun wurare a jiki ta ƙananan yanka. Tana gyara siffar jiki; ba maganin rage nauyi ba ce.
treatments.liposuction.what: Ana sassauta kitse a cire shi ta siraran bututu da ake shigarwa ta ƙananan yanka, daga wurare kamar ciki, cinyoyi, hannaye ko wuya. Ana sanya tufafi mai matsewa daga baya don taimaka wa fata ta zauna.
treatments.liposuction.who: Manya da ke kusa da lafiyayyen nauyi masu wuraren kitse da ba sa tafiya da abinci da motsa jiki.
treatments.liposuction.stay: Yawanci aiki ne na rana ɗaya ko dare 1 a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.liposuction.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa aikin ofis cikin mako ɗaya. Kumburi yana wucewa cikin makonni zuwa watanni.
treatments.liposuction.faq.0.question: Shin hanya ce ta rage nauyi?
treatments.liposuction.faq.0.answer: A'a. Tana gyara siffar jiki. Don nauyi mai yawa, tiyatar rage nauyi na iya fi dacewa.
treatments.liposuction.faq.1.question: Kitsen zai dawo?
treatments.liposuction.faq.1.answer: Ƙwayoyin kitsen da aka cire ba sa dawowa, amma ƙaruwar nauyi na iya ƙara kitse a wasu wurare.
treatments.hair-transplant.name: Dashen gashi (FUE)
treatments.hair-transplant.summary: Ana ɗauko tushen gashi ɗaya bayan ɗaya daga bayan kai ko gefensa zuwa wuraren da gashi ya ragu ko kai ya yi sanƙo.
treatments.hair-transplant.what: Da maganin kashe jin wuri ɗaya, ana ɗauko lafiyayyun tushen gashi ɗaya bayan ɗaya daga bayan kai ko gefensa (follicular unit extraction) a dasa su a wuraren da gashi ya ragu. Yana ɗaukar mafi yawan yini.
treatments.hair-transplant.who: Maza da mata masu zubewar gashi irin ta gado ko raguwar gashi, waɗanda ke da isasshen lafiyayyen gashi a baya da gefen kai.
treatments.hair-transplant.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: aiki ne na rana ɗaya.
treatments.hair-transplant.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu cikin ʼyan kwanaki. Sabon gashin yana zubewa da farko sannan ya sake fitowa cikin watanni 3 zuwa 12.
treatments.hair-transplant.faq.0.answer: Sabon gashi yana fara fitowa cikin kusan watanni 3 zuwa 4, kuma cikakken sakamako yana bayyana a kusan shekara ɗaya.
treatments.hair-transplant.faq.1.questio: Zan iya tashi zuwa gida washegari?
treatments.hair-transplant.faq.1.answer: Yawanci eh, bayan an duba wuraren da aka yi wa magani.
treatments.cataract-surgery.name: Tiyatar yanar ido (cataract) da ruwan tabarau na musamman (IOL)
treatments.cataract-surgery.summary: Ana cire ruwan tabaran ido na asali da ya yi gajimare a maye gurbinsa da ruwan tabarau na wucin gadi mai haske.
treatments.cataract-surgery.what: Ta ɗan ƙaramin yanka, ana farfasa ruwan tabaran da ya yi gajimare da ultrasound (phacoemulsification) ko da taimakon laser na femtosecond, sannan a sanya naɗaɗɗen ruwan tabarau na wucin gadi (IOL) a wurinsa. Ruwan tabarau na musamman na iya gyara astigmatism ko ba da gani mai kyau a nisa fiye da ɗaya. Kowane ido yana ɗaukar kusan mintuna 15 zuwa 30, da digon maganin kashe ji.
treatments.cataract-surgery.who: Mutanen da yanar idonsu ke sa ganinsu ya yi gajimare, duhu ko walƙiya har ya hana su harkokin yau da kullum.
treatments.cataract-surgery.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: aiki ne na rana ɗaya. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.cataract-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna gani da kyau cikin ʼyan kwanaki kuma suna komawa harkoki masu sauƙi cikin mako ɗaya. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan mako ɗaya bayan ido na farko; ana yawan yin ido na biyu bayan ʼyan kwanaki.
treatments.cataract-surgery.faq.0.questi: Ana iya yin idanu biyu a tafiya ɗaya?
treatments.cataract-surgery.faq.0.answer: Yawanci eh. Ana yawan yin ido na biyu bayan ʼyan kwanaki zuwa mako ɗaya bayan na farko, bayan an duba ido na farko.
treatments.cataract-surgery.faq.1.answer: Ya danganta da ruwan tabaran da kuka zaɓa. Ruwan tabarau na musamman na iya rage buƙatar tabarau; likitan fiɗa zai bayyana zaɓuɓɓukan bayan ya auna idanunku.
treatments.lasik.name: Gyaran gani da laser: LASIK, Femto-LASIK da CLEAR
treatments.lasik.summary: Laser yana gyara siffar gaban ido mai haske (cornea) domin kada a ƙara buƙatar tabarau ko ruwan tabarau na ido (contact lenses).
treatments.lasik.what: Ana gyara siffar cornea da laser domin haske ya mayar da hankali daidai a kan retina. A LASIK da Femto-LASIK mara reza, ana ɗaga siririn murfi kafin laser ya yi aiki; a CLEAR, ana cire ɗan ƙaramin nama ta ɗan ƙaramin rami ba tare da murfi ba. Yawanci ana yin idanu biyu a zama ɗaya, wanda ke ɗaukar kusan mintuna 15 zuwa 30, da digon maganin kashe ji.
treatments.lasik.who: Manya sama da shekaru 18 waɗanda ƙarfin tabarunsu bai canza ba aƙalla shekara ɗaya, masu lafiyayyun idanu da cornea mai kauri isasshe don maganin. Cikakkun hotunan ido ne ke yanke wace hanya ta dace da ku.
treatments.lasik.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: aiki ne na rana ɗaya. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.lasik.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna gani sarai cikin kwana ɗaya ko biyu kuma suna komawa aiki cikin ʼyan kwanaki. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan mako ɗaya don duba bayan aiki.
treatments.lasik.faq.0.question: Shin yana da zafi?
treatments.lasik.faq.0.answer: A'a. Ana amfani da digon maganin kashe ji, kuma yawancin mutane suna jin ɗan matsi kawai. Idanu na iya jin kamar akwai yashi a ciki na kusan kwana ɗaya bayan haka.
treatments.lasik.faq.1.question: Ta yaya zan san wace hanyar laser ta dace da ni?
treatments.lasik.faq.1.answer: Likitan fiɗa yana yanke shawara bayan hotunan cornea ɗinku. Rahotannin ku daga gida suna taimaka mana mu ba ku ra'ayin farko kafin ku yi tafiya.
treatments.icl.name: Ruwan tabarau da ake sanyawa cikin ido (ICL)
treatments.icl.summary: Ana sanya siririn ruwan tabarau a cikin ido don gyara babban ƙarfin tabarau, ga mutanen da ba za a iya yi musu maganin laser ba.
treatments.icl.what: Ta ɗan ƙaramin yanka, ana sanya ruwan tabarau mai laushi da sirara a cikin ido a gaban ruwan tabaran ido na asali. Ana barin ruwan tabaran asali, kuma ana iya cire ICL daga baya idan an buƙata. Kowane ido yana ɗaukar kusan mintuna 20 zuwa 30, da digon maganin kashe ji.
treatments.icl.who: Manya masu tsananin rashin ganin nesa ko astigmatism, ko cornea da ta yi sirara sosai don LASIK.
treatments.icl.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: aiki ne na rana ɗaya. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.icl.recovery: Gani yawanci yana inganta cikin kwana ɗaya ko biyu. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan mako ɗaya don dubawa.
treatments.icl.faq.0.question: Zan ji ruwan tabaran a idona?
treatments.icl.faq.0.answer: A'a. Ruwan tabaran yana zaune a cikin ido kuma ba a jin sa bayan an sanya shi.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.name: Maganin keratoconus (corneal cross-linking)
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.summary: Magani da ke hana cornea mai siriri da ke zama kamar mazugi ƙara lalacewa, kuma yana taimaka wa gani da ruwan tabarau na musamman.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.what: A corneal cross-linking, ana zuba digon bitamin B2 (riboflavin) a ido sannan a haska masa hasken ultraviolet da aka auna. Wannan yana ƙarfafa cornea kuma yana hana mazugin ƙara tsawo. Daga nan ruwan tabarau na musamman ko ruwan tabarau da ake dasawa na iya inganta gani.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.who: Yara da manya waɗanda keratoconus ɗinsu ke ƙara muni, kamar yadda maimaita hotunan cornea suka nuna.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: aiki ne na rana ɗaya. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.recover: Ido yana ciwo na ʼyan kwanaki yayin da saman ido ke warkewa. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan mako ɗaya don dubawa.
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.faq.0.q: Cross-linking zai dawo min da gani?
treatments.keratoconus-treatment.faq.0.a: Babbar manufarsa ita ce hana keratoconus ƙara muni. Daga nan ana taimaka wa gani da ruwan tabarau; likita zai bayyana abin da za ku iya tsammani ga idonku.
treatments.corneal-transplant.name: Dashen cornea (keratoplasty)
treatments.corneal-transplant.summary: Ana maye gurbin cornea da ta lalace ko ta yi tabo, gaba ɗaya ko a matakai, da lafiyayyen nama daga mai bayarwa.
treatments.corneal-transplant.what: Ana cire ɓangaren cornea da ya lalace a maye gurbinsa da nama mai haske daga idon mai bayarwa. Gwargwadon matsalar, ana maye gurbin dukkan kaurin ko matakan gaba ko na baya kawai. Naman mai bayarwa yana fitowa ne daga bankin ido da aka amince da shi.
treatments.corneal-transplant.who: Mutanen da ke da cornea mai tabo, gajimare ko wadda siffarta ta lalace sosai, misali daga kamuwa da cuta, rauni ko keratoconus mai tsanani.
treatments.corneal-transplant.stay: Yawanci aiki ne na rana ɗaya ko dare ɗaya a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.corneal-transplant.recovery: Gani yana inganta a hankali cikin watanni. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan makonni 2 zuwa 3 don dubawa sosai, da amfani da digon ido na dogon lokaci bayan haka.
treatments.corneal-transplant.faq.0.ques: Daga ina cornea na mai bayarwa take fitowa?
treatments.corneal-transplant.faq.0.answ: Daga bankin ido. A Indiya, ana iya yin dashen cornea ne kawai a asibitocin da aka amince musu a ƙarƙashin dokar Indiya.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.name: Maganin glaucoma (hawan matsin ido)
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.summary: Digo, laser ko tiyata don rage matsi a cikin ido da kare gani daga glaucoma.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.what: Glaucoma tana lalata jijiyar da ke bayan ido a hankali, yawanci saboda matsin da ke cikin ido ya yi yawa. Magani yana rage matsin: da farko da digon ido, sannan da laser, kuma idan an buƙata da tiyata da ke yin sabuwar hanyar fitar ruwan ido.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.who: Mutanen da aka gano suna da glaucoma, ko masu hawan matsin ido da ke jefa ganinsu cikin haɗari.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti don laser; aikin rana ɗaya ko dare ɗaya don tiyata. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.recovery: Laser yana buƙatar ɗan hutu kaɗan kawai. Bayan tiyata, ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan makonni 2 don dubawa.
treatments.glaucoma-treatment.faq.0.answ: A'a. Ganin da ya riga ya ɓace ba za a iya dawo da shi ba, shi ya sa magani yake nufin kare ganin da ya rage.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.name: Tiyatar retina da vitreo-retina
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.summary: Laser, allura ko tiyata don matsalolin bayan ido, kamar ɓallewar retina ko cutar ido ta ciwon suga.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.what: Gwargwadon matsalar, ana yi wa retina magani da laser, da allura cikin ido, ko da vitrectomy: ana cire ruwa mai kauri da ke cikin ido domin likitan fiɗa ya gyara retina. Ana mayar da retina da ta ɓalle wurinta a riƙe ta da iskar gas ko mai.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.who: Mutanen da retinarsu ta ɓalle ko ta tsage, masu zubar jini a cikin ido, cutar ido ta ciwon suga, ramin macula ko lalacewar macula saboda tsufa.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.stay: Yawanci aiki ne na rana ɗaya; wani lokaci dare ɗaya a asibiti. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.recover: Murmurewa ta danganta da irin tiyatar. Bayan vitrectomy kuna iya buƙatar riƙe kanku a wuri ɗaya na wasu kwanaki, kuma ba za ku iya hawa jirgin sama ba yayin da akwai gas a cikin ido. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan makonni 2 zuwa 3.
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.faq.0.q: Yaushe zan iya tashi zuwa gida?
treatments.vitreoretinal-surgery.faq.0.a: Ba yayin da kumfar gas take cikin ido ba, wanda zai iya ɗaukar ʼyan makonni. Likitan fiɗa zai gaya muku lokacin da babu haɗari.
treatments.squint-surgery.name: Tiyatar ƙyallin ido (squint) da kulawar idon yara
treatments.squint-surgery.summary: Tiyata a kan tsokokin ido don daidaita idanun da ke karkata ciki, waje, sama ko ƙasa, ga yara da manya.
treatments.squint-surgery.what: Ana matse ko sassauta tsokokin da ke motsa ido domin idanu su daidaita. Ana kuma duba ganin yara don rauni a ido ɗaya (lazy eye) da buƙatar tabarau kafin a tsara wata tiyata.
treatments.squint-surgery.who: Yara da manya masu ƙyallin ido da tabarau ko motsa jiki ba su gyara ba.
treatments.squint-surgery.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: aiki ne na rana ɗaya. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.squint-surgery.recovery: Ido yana yin ja da ciwo na mako ɗaya ko biyu. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan mako ɗaya.
treatments.squint-surgery.faq.0.question: Ana yin tiyatar da maganin sa barci gaba ɗaya?
treatments.squint-surgery.faq.0.answer: Ga yara, yawanci eh. Manya a wasu lokuta ana yi musu da maganin kashe jin wuri ɗaya.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.name: Tiyatar fatar ido da kewayen ido (oculoplastic)
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.summary: Tiyata ga fatar ido, hanyoyin hawaye da ƙasusuwan da ke kewaye da ido.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.what: Tiyata a kan fatar ido (kamar fatar ido da ta faɗi ko wadda ke juyawa ciki ko waje), tsarin fitar hawaye (kamar toshewar hanyar hawaye) da kwanon ido, ciki har da cire tsiro da sake gina wuri bayan rauni.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.who: Mutanen da ke da matsalar fatar ido, hanyar hawaye ko kwanon ido, saboda dalilan lafiya ko na kyan gani.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.stay: Yawanci aiki ne na rana ɗaya. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.recovery: Kumburi da ɓarɓashin jini suna wucewa cikin makonni 1 zuwa 2. Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan mako ɗaya zuwa kwanaki 10, har sai an cire ɗinki.
treatments.oculoplastic-surgery.faq.0.an: Yawanci ana ɓoye yanka a cikin naɗe-naɗen fatar ido na asali, don haka tabo yana da wuyar gani bayan ya warke.
treatments.dental-implants.name: Dashen haƙori (dental implants)
treatments.dental-implants.summary: Ana sanya turken titanium a cikin muƙamuƙi don riƙe sabon haƙori a inda wani ya ɓace.
treatments.dental-implants.what: Ana sanya ƙaramin turken titanium a cikin ƙashin muƙamuƙi da maganin kashe jin wuri ɗaya. Bayan ƙashin ya girma ya kewaye shi, ana ɗaura kambi (crown), gada (bridge) ko haƙoran roba a saman shi. Wasu yanayi suna ba da damar sanya haƙori na wucin gadi a rana ɗaya.
treatments.dental-implants.who: Manya da haƙori ɗaya ko fiye ya ɓace kuma suna da isasshen lafiyayyen ƙashin muƙamuƙi, ko waɗanda za a iya fara yi musu dashen ƙashi.
treatments.dental-implants.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: kowace ziyara ganawa ce a asibitin haƙori. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.dental-implants.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu washegari. Ƙashi yana ɗaukar kusan watanni 3 zuwa 6 kafin ya warke ya kewaye turken, don haka ana yawan raba magani zuwa tafiye-tafiye biyu, sai dai idan likitan haƙori zai iya sanya haƙorin ƙarshe da wuri.
treatments.dental-implants.faq.0.questio: Ana iya yi a tafiya ɗaya?
treatments.dental-implants.faq.0.answer: Wani lokaci. Ya danganta da ƙashinku da irin turken. Likitan haƙori zai gaya muku bayan ya ga hotunan X-ray ɗinku.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.name: Maganin tushen haƙori (root canal)
treatments.root-canal-treatment.summary: Ana tsabtace cikin haƙori da ya kamu da cuta a rufe shi, domin a riƙe haƙorin maimakon a cire shi.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.what: Da maganin kashe jin wuri ɗaya, ana cire ɓangaren ciki na haƙori (pulp) da ya kamu da cuta ko ya lalace, a tsabtace hanyoyin a gyara siffarsu, sannan a cike su a rufe. Ana yawan sanya kambi (crown) daga baya don kare haƙorin.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.who: Mutanen da ke da haƙori da ya ruɓe sosai, ya tsage ko ya kamu da cuta wanda ke haddasa ciwo ko kumburi.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: yawanci ziyara 1 zuwa 3 a asibitin haƙori. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.recovery: Haƙorin na iya yin laushi na ʼyan kwanaki. Yawancin mutane suna komawa cin abinci kamar da cikin mako ɗaya.
treatments.root-canal-treatment.faq.0.an: Ana yin sa da maganin kashe jin wuri ɗaya, don haka ya kamata ya ji kamar cike haƙori na yau da kullum.
treatments.smile-design.name: Tsara murmushi da gyaran kyan haƙori
treatments.smile-design.summary: Veneers, farar da haƙori da cike haƙori mai launin haƙori don inganta kyan murmushinku.
treatments.smile-design.what: Likitan haƙori yana tsara siffa, girma da launin haƙoranku, sannan ya yi amfani da veneers ko laminates, farar da haƙori, cike haƙori mai launin haƙori ko kambi (crown) don cimma wannan kamannin.
treatments.smile-design.who: Mutanen da ke son canza haƙora masu tabo, gutsure, rashin daidaito ko wawaye.
treatments.smile-design.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: yawanci ʼyan ziyarori a asibitin haƙori cikin makonni 1 zuwa 2. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.smile-design.recovery: Babu lokacin murmurewa ga yawancin magunguna. Haƙora na iya jin zafi ko sanyi na ʼyan kwanaki.
treatments.smile-design.faq.0.question: Har yaushe veneers suke ɗorewa?
treatments.smile-design.faq.0.answer: Veneers na porcelain yawanci suna ɗorewa shekaru 10 ko fiye idan an kula da su da kyau.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.sum: Jerin magunguna da aka tsara wanda ke sake gina dukkan haƙora idan da yawa sun zaizaye, sun karye ko sun ɓace.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.wha: Ana tsara haɗin kambi, gada, dashen haƙori, maganin tushen haƙori da kulawar dasashi tare don sake gina cizo da kyan haƙora.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.who: Mutanen da ke da haƙora da yawa da suka lalace ko suka ɓace, cizo da ya zaizaye, ko matsaloli daga tsoffin magunguna da dama.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.sta: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: jerin ziyarori a asibitin haƙori. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.rec: Ya danganta da tsarin. Ana iya yin wasu ayyuka a tafiya ɗaya ta makonni 1 zuwa 2; tsare-tsare masu dashen haƙori na iya buƙatar tafiya ta biyu.
treatments.full-mouth-rehabilitation.faq: Likitan haƙori yana tsara shirin bayan ya ga hotunan X-ray ɗinku kuma ya gaya muku ziyarori nawa ake buƙata.
treatments.braces-aligners.name: Wayar haƙori (braces) da clear aligners
treatments.braces-aligners.summary: Wayar haƙori ko clear aligners da ke motsa haƙora a hankali zuwa matsayi mafi daidaito.
treatments.braces-aligners.what: Wayar haƙori da aka ɗaure ko clear aligners da ake cirewa suna sanya matsi mai sauƙi don motsa haƙora cikin watanni. Likitan haƙori yana ɗaukar hotuna ko samfuri kuma yana tsara kowane mataki.
treatments.braces-aligners.who: Yara da manya masu haƙora karkatattu, cunkushe ko wawaye, ko cizo da ba ya haɗuwa daidai.
treatments.braces-aligners.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: ziyarori a asibitin haƙori. Asibitin ku zai tabbatar da shi don yanayin ku.
treatments.braces-aligners.recovery: Magani yawanci yana ɗaukar watanni 6 zuwa 24. Da aligners, ana iya yin yawancin dubawa daga gida bayan ziyarar farko.
treatments.braces-aligners.faq.0.questio: Za a iya yi min magani idan ina zaune a ƙasar waje?
treatments.braces-aligners.faq.0.answer: Sau da yawa eh da clear aligners: ziyarar farko ana yin ta ne da kai, kuma ana iya aiko muku da sauran aligners daga baya.

hospitals.kenia-eye.overview: Asibitin ido na ƙwararru a Santacruz, Mumbai, wanda ke kula da majiyyata tun 1998. Dr. Vaishal Kenia ne ke jagorantarsa, likitan fiɗar yanar ido (cataract) da gyaran gani, tare da ƙungiyar likitoci da masu ba da shawara da ke kula da kowane ɓangare na lafiyar ido. An amince masa ya yi dashen cornea kuma yana da laser mara reza na FEMTO Z8 NEO, na farko a Yammacin Indiya, tare da na'urorin hoto na zamani kamar IOL Master 700, Pentacam, Verion da hoton retina mai faɗi na OPTOS. Yana magance komai daga yanar ido da LASIK zuwa matsalolin cornea, glaucoma, retina, ƙyallin ido da fatar ido. Kenia Dental Clinic, wadda Dr. Pallavi Kenia ke gudanarwa, tana cikin gini ɗaya.

hospitals.kenia-dental.overview: Asibitin haƙori mai fannoni da dama a Santacruz (West), Mumbai, wanda Dr. Pallavi Kenia ke jagoranta, likitar haƙori fiye da shekaru 20. Ta yi shekaru takwas a Jain Health Centre, wata cibiyar agaji a Dadar, Mumbai, inda ta yi wa majiyyata fiye da 100,000 magani, kafin ta buɗe Kenia Dental Clinic don ba da magani na zamani a farashi mai sauƙi. Yana cikin gini ɗaya da Kenia Eye Hospital.

posts.bilateral-hand-transplant-nanavati: Dashen hannaye biyu ya dawo wa matashi ɗan shekara 18 hannayensa
Wani matashin manomi da ya rasa hannayensa biyu a hatsari ya karɓi hannaye biyu daga mai bayarwa a tiyatar awa 13 a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mumbai.

A watan Janairu 2024, wani ɗan manomi ɗan shekara 18 daga Gujarat ya rasa hannayensa biyu a hatsari da injin gona. Raunin murƙushewa ya yi tsanani sosai da ba za a iya gyara shi ba, kuma dole aka yanke hannayen biyu.

Bayan cikakkun gwaje-gwajen lafiya, na tunani da na garkuwar jiki, likitoci sun ga ya dace da dashen hannaye biyu. Hannayen masu bayarwa ba su da yawa kuma dole su dace sosai, don haka ya jira watanni 13.

A watan Janairu 2026 iyalin wata mace ʼyar shekara 50 da ta rasu a Surat sun amince su ba da gudummawar sassan jikinta. Huhunta, hantarta da cornea ɗinta sun tafi ga majiyyata a Mumbai da Surat, hannayenta kuma gare shi. Ƙungiyoyi a Gujarat da Maharashtra sun yi aiki tare don kawo hannayen zuwa Mumbai cikin ɗan gajeren lokacin da ake da shi.

An yi tiyatar a daren 9 zuwa 10 ga Janairu 2026, ƙarƙashin jagorancin Dr Nilesh Satbhai, Daraktan Tiyatar Gyaran Jiki, Sake Gina Jiki ta Microsurgery da Dashen Hannu. Cikin awa 13 ƙungiyar ta ɗaure ƙasusuwa, ta haɗa jijiyoyin jini, ta gyara tendon, ta haɗa jijiyoyin ji kuma ta rufe fata. Jini ya gudana cikin hannayen biyu da zarar an haɗa jijiyoyin.

Bayan haka ƙungiya ta kula da shi wadda ta sarrafa magani don hana jiki ƙin hannayen, ta sa ido sosai kan gudanar jini, ta hana kamuwa da cuta kuma ta fara gyaran motsi da wuri. Wannan shi ne dashen hannaye biyu na farko a Nanavati Max.

Dashen hannu ya fi dashen gaɓar ciki wuya, domin yana ɗauko fata, tsoka, tendon, ƙashi, jijiyoyin jini da jijiyoyin ji tare, kuma jiki yana iya ƙin fata sosai. Idan ya yi nasara, zai iya dawo da ji da motsi mai daidaito wanda hannun roba ba zai iya ba.
Idan ku ko wani a cikin iyalinku ya rasa hannu ko damtse, ku aiko mana da rahotannin lafiya. Ƙwararre zai gaya muku ko dashe ko sake gina jiki zai iya taimakawa.
Majiyyacin tare da likitoci, ma'aikatan jinya da ma'aikatan Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital da suka kula da shi

posts.thumb-reconstruction-toddler-nanav: An haife ta ba babban yatsa: yadda likitocin fiɗa suka sake gina damƙar wata ƙaramar yarinya
Wata jaririya da aka haifa da tsananin naƙasar babban yatsa a hannayenta biyu yanzu tana iya damƙa da riƙe abu, bayan tiyata biyu a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mumbai.

An haifi wata ƙaramar yarinya ba babban yatsa a hannun hagu, kuma babban yatsan hannun damanta bai girma isasshe da za a yi amfani da shi ba. Ba tare da manyan yatsu masu aiki ba, yaro yana shan wahala wajen koyon kama, tsunkula da riƙe abubuwa.

Dr Nilesh G Satbhai, Daraktan Tiyatar Gyaran Jiki, Sake Gina Jiki ta Microsurgery da Dashen Hannu, da ƙungiyarsa sun tsara tiyata biyu. Jijiyoyin jininta da jijiyoyin jinta ƙanana ne sosai, wanda ya sa aikin ya zama mai laushi, kuma saboda hannayen biyu ne abin ya shafa, dole tiyatocin biyu su yi nasara.

Tiyatar farko, a watan Disamba 2025, ta ƙarfafa raunannen babban yatsan dama kuma ta ɗauko wata tsoka daga tafin hannunta domin babban yatsan ya iya juyawa ya taɓa sauran yatsu. Cikin ʼyan makonni ta fara amfani da shi.

Ta biyu, a watan Fabrairu 2026, ta gina sabon babban yatsa na hagu ta hanyar ɗauko yatsan ƙafa na biyu daga ƙafarta ta hagu zuwa hannunta da haɗa jijiyoyin jininsa, jijiyoyin ji da tendon ƙarƙashin madubin hangen nesa. Likitocin fiɗa sun kuma sake gina ƙafar domin ta ci gaba da aiki kamar yadda aka saba.
Tana da watanni 13 tana iya riƙe yatsun iyayenta. Tiyata irin wannan ta fi aiki idan aka yi ta da wuri, yayin da yaro yake koyon amfani da hannayensa.
Idan an haifi ɗanku da bambancin hannu, ku aiko mana da hotuna da duk wani rahoto. Ƙwararre zai ba ku shawara kan abin da za a iya yi da lokacin yin sa.

bodyAreas.1.hint: Gani mai gajimare, tabarau da kuke son rabuwa da su, glaucoma ko matsalar retina, ƙyallin ido ko fatar ido da ta faɗi, haƙora da suka ɓace ko suka lalace, cutar daji ta baki ko maƙogwaro, tsagewar leɓe ko ɗanɗano, ko canza siffar hanci.

bodyAreas.3.name: Wuya
bodyAreas.3.hint: Ciwon wuya ko sanyin hannu daga faifan da ya lalace, ƙullin thyroid, ko cutar daji a maƙogwaro ko wuya.
bodyAreas.4.name: Ƙirji, zuciya da nono
bodyAreas.4.hint: Ciwon ƙirji, toshewar jijiyoyin zuciya, ƙofar zuciya da ta lalace, ciwon suga mai haɗarin zuciya, ko ƙulli a nono.
bodyAreas.5.name: Ciki, hanta da hanji
bodyAreas.5.hint: Gazawar hanta ko hanji, cutar daji ta hanta, saifa, ciki ko hanji, ciwon suga, ko nauyi da ke jefa lafiya cikin haɗari.
bodyAreas.6.name: Koda
bodyAreas.6.hint: Kodar da ta daina aiki, wankin koda (dialysis), ko tsiro a cikin koda.
bodyAreas.7.name: Baya da kashin baya
bodyAreas.7.hint: Ciwon baya, ciwon ƙafa ko sanyin ƙafa daga faifan da ya zame, ko kashin baya mara ƙarfi ko mai lanƙwasa.
bodyAreas.8.name: Mahaifa, mafitsara da haihuwa
bodyAreas.8.hint: Wahalar samun ciki, ko cutar daji ta mahaifa, kwayayen mace (ovaries), bakin mahaifa, mafitsara ko prostate.
bodyAreas.9.name: Kwatangwalo
bodyAreas.9.hint: Ciwon kwatangwalo, tauri ko gaɓar kwatangwalo da ta lalace.
bodyAreas.10.name: Gwiwoyi
bodyAreas.10.hint: Ciwon gwiwa daga amosanin gaɓoɓi, ko jijiyar gwiwa da ta tsage bayan raunin wasanni.
bodyAreas.11.name: Ƙafafu
bodyAreas.11.hint: Varicose veins, ciwon ƙafa yayin tafiya, ciwon ƙashi (tumour), ƙafa da ta ji mummunan rauni, ko ƙafa da ta kumbura.
bodyAreas.12.name: Damtse da hannaye
bodyAreas.12.hint: Rasa hannu, hannaye da suka ji rauni ko suka yi tauri, raunin damtse bayan raunin jijiyar ji, ko damtse da ya kumbura.
